project.description: Podle obsahu runu v TestRailu vybere testy, spusti je (robot), posle vysledky do TestRailu pres TRCLI a vygeneruje report s odkazem v popisu runu i buildu.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: TAG
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Tag do nazvu runu (jako %TAG% na projektu)

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: RUN_ID
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: ID test runu v TestRailu (z URL)

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: APP_VERSION
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Verze testovane aplikace, zapise se do pole Version u kazdeho vysledku

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: REPORT_TEMPLATE_ID
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: ID API sablony reportu v TestRailu (prazdne = report negenerovat)

hudson.tasks.BatchFile.command:
@echo off rem === Priprava prostredi === python -m venv .venv call .venv\Scripts\activate.bat python -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt trcli
for /f %%i in ('powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Date -Format yyyy-MM-dd"') do set TODAY=%%i for /f %%i in ('powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Date -Format HH:mm"') do set NOW=%%i
rem === 1) Vyber testu podle obsahu runu v TestRailu (automation_id) === python tools\select-tests.py --run-id %RUN_ID% if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
rem === 2) Spusteni jen vybranych testu === robot --argumentfile results\selected-tests.args --outputdir results tests
rem === 3) Odeslani vysledku do TestRailu (stejne jako na projektu) === trcli ^ -n ^ -h %TESTRAIL_HOST% ^ --project-id %PROJECT_ID% ^ --project "%TESTRAIL_PROJECT%" ^ --insecure ^ --username "%TESTRAIL_USER%" ^ --password "%TESTRAIL_API_KEY%" ^ parse_robot ^ --run-id %RUN_ID% ^ --case-matcher auto ^ --case-fields template_id:2 ^ --result-fields "version:%APP_VERSION%" ^ --milestone-id %MILESTONE% ^ --run-description "%BUILD_URL%" ^ -f "results/output.xml" if errorlevel 1 ( echo TRCLI nenahralo vysledky do TestRailu. exit /b 1 )
rem === 4) Report v TestRailu pres API a odkaz do popisu runu === if not "%REPORT_TEMPLATE_ID%"=="" powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\publish-report.ps1 -RunId %RUN_ID% -TemplateId %REPORT_TEMPLATE_ID% exit /b 0
